[[Los Angeles]], [[California]] | country = United States | presenter = [[Screen Actors Guild]] | reward = | holder = | host = | preshow_host = | acts = | network = [[TNT (American TV network)|TNT]] | runtime = | ratings = | producer = | director = | most_awards = | most_nominations = | website = {{URL|www.sagawards.org}} | image2 = | image2size = | alt2 = | caption2 = | previous = [[5th Screen Actors Guild Awards|5th]] | main = [[Screen Actors Guild Awards]] | next = [[7th Screen Actors Guild Awards|7th]] }} The '''6th Screen Actors Guild Awards''', awarded by the [[Screen Actors Guild]] and honoring the best achievements in film and television performances for the year 1999, took place on March 12, 2000. The ceremony was held at the [[Shrine Auditorium|Shrine Exposition Center]] in [[Los Angeles]], California, and was televised live by [[TNT (American TV network)|TNT]].{{cite web|title=Screen Actors Guild Honors Outstanding Film and Television Performances in 13 Categories at the 6th Annual Screen Actors Guild Awards|url=http://www.sagawards.org:80/press_releases/pr_000312.html|publisher=Screen Actors Guild|access-date=June 24, 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20000815223302/http://www.sagawards.org/press_releases/pr_000312.html|archive-date=August 15, 2000|date=March 12, 2000|url-status=dead}}{{cite news|title=Beauty bandwagon rolls on|url=https://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/entertainment/675752.stm|access-date=June 24, 2017|work=BBC News|date=March 13, 2000|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160306025317/http://news.bbc.co.uk/2/hi/entertainment/675752.stm|archive-date=March 6, 2016|url-status=live}} The nominees were announced on February 1, 2000, by [[Lolita Davidovich]] and [[Blair Underwood]].{{cite web|title=Nominations announced for the 6th Annual Screen Actors Guild Awards|url=http://www.sagawards.org/press_releases/pr_000201.html|publisher=Screen Actors Guild|access-date=June 24, 2017|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20000407211829/http://www.sagawards.org/press_releases/pr_000201.html|archive-date=April 7, 2000|date=February 1, 2000|url-status=dead}}{{cite news|last1=King|first1=Susan|title='American Beauty' Plucks 4 SAG Film Nominations|url=https://www.latimes.com/archives/la-xpm-2000-feb-02-ca-60068-story.html|access-date=June 24, 2017|work=Los Angeles Times|date=February 2, 2000|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160306202809/http://articles.latimes.com/2000/feb/02/entertainment/ca-60068|archive-date=March 6, 2016|url-status=live}} ==Winners and nominees== Winners are listed first and highlighted in '''boldface'''.
